title: Effectiveness, user acceptability and sustainability of Arsiron Nilogon: a rural technology for arsenic removal from drinking water
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00007F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Saranga Baishya, Shamiran Baroi, Tushmita Das, Rituparna Saikia, Robin K. Dutta
Field implementation of Arsiron Nilogon in a village has shown the low-cost method to be a highly effective, user-friendly and sustainable solution for arsenic mitigation in a rural setup.
